title: Delightful Species
description: An integration datapack between Species and Dungeon Delights
body:
Delightful Species is a datapack that integrates some of [Species](https://modrinth.com/mod/species) mod items for certain [Dungeon's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons_delight) content, range from drops to food recipe. 


Current Features includes:
- Bug Chops dropped from Leaf and Cliff Hangers via Scavenging. (**Make sure to enable forceEnableCompatItems in the config).**
- Chance of Rotten Tripes dropped from Mammutilation via Scavenging.
- Wraptor and Cruncher eggs as alternative Monster Cake ingredient.
- Some of Goober ancient plants as alternative ingredient for Sniffers Food.
- Frozen Meat as alternative ingredient for certain undead meat based food.
- Ghoul Tongue as alternative ingredient for Ghoulash and Shiokara.
- Birt Egg as alternative ingredient for Embedded Eggs

Feel free to gives a feedback for this datapack for stuff like the recipes used for the food, or mob drops.
